snippet.description:
I finally made the Minecraft world I always wanted to make, 13 years later

Check out our new MrBeast Lab MEGA Mutators at Walmart! 👉 https://www.walmart.com/ip/MEGA-PNTHR/19203372461?classType=REGULAR

The laptop I originally used to record the first episodes was destroyed, so we used the original seed and painstakingly recreated every block to make it the exact same that I had 13 years ago. If you want to play on this world, download it here: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ODgKBHIXMKU9v2IZiedkppHA6m95ze6G/view?usp=sharing
